newsitem.title: JAPAN: Seiyu shares down on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: Seiyu shares down on technical selling.

text.p: Shares in Seiyu Ltd fell in Thursday morning trade due to technical selling, traders said.
The share price of the supermarket operator lost 70 yen to 1,130 by midday, which made it the largest percentage loser in the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Trade volume in Seiyu this morning was 573,000 shares.
Traders said Seiyu's share price fell towards 1,128 yen, the conversion price of the firm's convertible bonds, which listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Thursday.
